title: Dojava o bombi na izraelskom kruzeru u Grčkoj
Bomb threat on an Israeli cruise ship in Greece
body: Grčka obalska straža pretražuje izraelski kruzer Crown Iris u luci na ostrvu Siros.
The Greek coast guard is searching the Israeli cruise ship Crown Iris in a port on the island of Syros.
Nepoznata osoba dojavila je da je na trup broda postavljena eksplozivna naprava.
An unknown person reported that an explosive device had been placed on the ship's hull.
Brod vodi izraelska kompanija Mano Maritime, a plovi pod zastavom Paname.
The ship is run by the Israeli company Mano Maritime, and it sails under the flag of Panama.
Kruzer je trebao ploviti prema Hajfi u Izraelu, a na njemu je 940 putnika i 597 članova posade.
The cruise ship was due to sail to Haifa in Israel, and it has 940 passengers and 597 crew members on board.
Zbog mjera sigurnosti zadržano je ukupno 1.537 ljudi.
Because of the security measures, a total of 1,537 people were held.
Obalska straža pretražila je brod psom za otkrivanje eksploziva, a pomogao im je i privatni ronilac.
The coast guard searched the ship with an explosives-detection dog, and a private diver helped them.
Na mjesto događaja poslana je i posebna jedinica.
A special unit was also sent to the scene.
Prvi pregled nije pronašao nikakvu eksplozivnu napravu.
The first inspection did not find any explosive device.
Stručnjaci obalske straže trebali bi doći oko 20:30 po bosanskom vremenu i obaviti dodatne provjere.
Coast guard specialists should arrive at about 20:30 Bosnian time and carry out further checks.
Ako ništa ne pronađu, brod bi mogao nastaviti putovanje.
If they find nothing, the ship could continue its voyage.
Prijetnje bombom prijavljene su i za najmanje sedam letova u Evropi, ali ni tamo nije pronađen eksploziv.
Bomb threats were also reported for at least seven flights in Europe, but no explosives were found there either.

title: Vodovod i stanovnici dogovorili kako će se vršiti redukcije vode
The water utility and residents agreed how water cuts will be carried out
body: Sarajevski Vodovod i kanalizacija (ViK) dogovorio je sa stanovnicima pet naselja kako će se vršiti redukcije vode.
The Sarajevo water utility (ViK) agreed with residents of five neighbourhoods how water reductions will be carried out.
Riječ je o naseljima Pogledine, Širokača, Komatin, Jarčedoli i Mahmutovac.
These are the neighbourhoods of Pogledine, Širokača, Komatin, Jarčedoli and Mahmutovac.
Redukcije će trajati dok traju nepovoljne hidrološke prilike, odnosno dok se stanje na izvorima ne stabilizira.
The reductions will last as long as the unfavourable hydrological conditions last, that is, until the situation at the water sources becomes stable.
ViK kaže da će pokušati rasporediti dostupnu vodu što racionalnije i svim korisnicima osigurati najbolje moguće snabdijevanje.
ViK says it will try to distribute the available water as sensibly as possible and give all users the best possible supply.
Dogovoreno je i da će se uspostaviti direktna komunikacija preko imenovanih kontakt osoba.
It was also agreed that direct communication will be set up through named contact persons.
Tako bi stanovnici bili na vrijeme obaviješteni, a problemi na terenu rješavali bi se brže.
This way residents would be informed in time, and problems on the ground would be solved faster.
Redukcije vode u Kantonu Sarajevo traju već sedmicama, a ViK navodi da je stanje na izvorima loše nakon višemjesečne suše.
Water reductions in Sarajevo Canton have been going on for weeks, and ViK says the situation at the sources is poor after a drought lasting several months.
Stanovnici Jarčedola i Pogledina danas su protestovali ispred direkcije ViK-a.
Residents of Jarčedoli and Pogledine protested today in front of the ViK headquarters.
Rekli su da mjesecima nemaju redovnu vodu, pogotovo noću.
They said that for months they have not had regular water, especially at night.
Dodali su da računi i dalje stižu kao i prije.
They added that the bills still arrive as before.

title: Tužilaštvo u Rimu preuzelo crnu kutiju helikoptera EUFOR-a
Prosecutors in Rome took the black box of the EUFOR helicopter
body: Tužilaštvo u Rimu preuzelo je crnu kutiju helikoptera Chinook koji se srušio kod Brčkog.
The prosecutor's office in Rome has taken over the black box of the Chinook helicopter that crashed near Brčko.
Uređaj je zabilježio cijeli let, kretanje helikoptera i sve podatke o njegovom radu.
The device recorded the whole flight, the movement of the helicopter and all data about its operation.
Stručnjaci italijanskog Ministarstva odbrane pregledat će ga u okviru opsežne istrage.
Experts of the Italian Ministry of Defence will examine it as part of a broad investigation.
Helikopter misije EUFOR Althea trebao je sletjeti na brčansku pistu da bi se promijenili piloti.
The helicopter of the EUFOR Althea mission was supposed to land on the Brčko airstrip so that the pilots could be changed.
Prilikom polijetanja izgubio je visinu i udario u tlo.
During takeoff it lost altitude and hit the ground.
Poginula su četiri italijanska pripadnika EUFOR-a, a jedna narednica preminula je u bolnici.
Four Italian members of EUFOR died, and one sergeant died in hospital.
Obdukcija u Rimu potvrdila je da su uzrok smrti teške povrede.
The autopsy in Rome confirmed that the cause of death was severe injuries.
Tužilac Francesco Saverio Musolino ponovo će saslušati preživjele čim im zdravlje to dopusti.
Prosecutor Francesco Saverio Musolino will question the survivors again as soon as their health allows.
Italijanska policija već je razgovarala s dijelom svjedoka i s trojicom pilota koji su bili u helikopteru.
Italian police have already spoken with some of the witnesses and with the three pilots who were in the helicopter.
Prema agenciji ANSA, glavna pretpostavka je tehnički kvar, jer su oba pilota imala iste komande.
According to the agency ANSA, the main assumption is a technical malfunction, because both pilots had the same controls.
Vojno tužilaštvo u Rimu otvorilo je i slučaj protiv nepoznatih osoba zbog sumnje na nemarno gubljenje letjelice.
The military prosecutor's office in Rome has also opened a case against unknown persons over suspected negligent loss of the aircraft.

title: Statham i Ritchie opet zajedno snimaju triler "Dogfight"
Statham and Ritchie make the thriller "Dogfight" together again
body: Netflix je najavio akcijski triler "Dogfight", a režira ga Guy Ritchie, dok glavnu ulogu igra Jason Statham.
Netflix has announced the action thriller "Dogfight", which is directed by Guy Ritchie, while Jason Statham plays the main role.
To je njihov sedmi zajednički film.
It is their seventh film together.
Netflix ga opisuje kao akcijski film o osveti u londonskom kriminalnom podzemlju.
Netflix describes it as an action film about revenge in London's criminal underworld.
Snimanje u Velikoj Britaniji počinje početkom 2027. godine.
Filming in the United Kingdom starts at the beginning of 2027.
Datum premijere i ostatak glumačke ekipe još nisu objavljeni.
The premiere date and the rest of the cast have not been announced yet.
Ritchie piše scenarij, režira i producira, a Statham je i producent.
Ritchie writes the script, directs and produces, and Statham is also a producer.
Film proizvode kompanije Black Bear Pictures, Toff Guy Films i Punch Palace Productions.
The film is produced by the companies Black Bear Pictures, Toff Guy Films and Punch Palace Productions.
Njihova saradnja počela je 1998. filmom "Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels", Ritchiejevim redateljskim debijem.
Their cooperation began in 1998 with the film "Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels", Ritchie's directing debut.
Za Stathama je to bila prva filmska uloga.
For Statham it was the first film role.
Zajedno su kasnije snimili i "Snatch", "Revolver" i "Wrath of Man".
Later they also made "Snatch", "Revolver" and "Wrath of Man" together.
Prije "Dogfighta" izaći će njihov film "Viva La Madness", nastavak filma "Layer Cake".
Before "Dogfight", their film "Viva La Madness", a sequel to "Layer Cake", will come out.

title: Đoković preokretom do pobjede i rekorda u Parizu
Đoković wins with a comeback and sets a record in Paris
body: Novak Đoković pobijedio je Valentina Vacherota iz Monaka rezultatom 2:1 u prvom kolu Mastersa u Parizu.
Novak Đoković beat Valentin Vacherot of Monaco 2:1 in the first round of the Masters in Paris.
Set rezultati bili su 6:7, 7:5 i 6:1, a meč je trajao oko dva i po sata.
The set scores were 6:7, 7:5 and 6:1, and the match lasted about two and a half hours.
Sa 39 godina Đoković je najstariji igrač koji je ikad dobio meč na ovom turniru.
At 39, Đoković is the oldest player who has ever won a match at this tournament.
U prvom setu spasio je tri set lopte pri rezultatu 5:6, a u taj-brejku je vodio 5:3.
In the first set he saved three set points at 5:6, and in the tiebreak he led 5:3.
Ipak, Vacherot je osvojio zadnja četiri poena i dobio set.
Still, Vacherot won the last four points and took the set.
U drugom setu Vacherot je poveo 2:0, ali je Đoković uzvratio brejkom, spasio tri brejk lopte kod 4:4 i set dobio brejkom kod 6:5.
In the second set Vacherot went ahead 2:0, but Đoković answered with a break, saved three break points at 4:4 and won the set with a break at 6:5.
U trećem setu brzo je poveo 4:0 i završio meč.
In the third set he quickly went ahead 4:0 and finished the match.
Time je prestigao Jimmyja Connorsa, koji je 1991. također pobijedio u Parizu sa 39 godina.
With this he passed Jimmy Connors, who also won in Paris at the age of 39 in 1991.
Bila je to njegova 51. pobjeda na ovom turniru i prva na Mastersu od marta u Indian Wellsu.
It was his 51st win at this tournament and his first at a Masters event since March in Indian Wells.
Prije toga je izgubio četiri meča zaredom na ovom nivou, što je njegova najduža takva serija.
Before that he had lost four matches in a row at this level, which is his longest such streak.
Sljedeći protivnik mu je australijski kvalifikant Rinky Hijikata.
His next opponent is the Australian qualifier Rinky Hijikata.
Da bi ostao u borbi za ATP Finale u Torinu, mora doći bar do polufinala.
To stay in the race for the ATP Finals in Turin, he has to reach at least the semifinals.

title: Za novu fiskalizaciju u Federaciji BiH planirano 42,3 miliona KM
42.3 million KM planned for new fiscalisation in the Federation of BiH
body: Federalno ministarstvo finansija u planu nabavki za 2026. predvidjelo je 42,3 miliona KM za novi sistem fiskalizacije.
In its procurement plan for 2026, the Federal Ministry of Finance planned 42.3 million KM for a new fiscalisation system.
Novac dolazi iz budžeta Porezne uprave FBiH, a nabavka će ići kroz otvoreni postupak s ugovorom na godinu dana.
The money comes from the budget of the FBiH Tax Administration, and the purchase will go through an open procedure with a one-year contract.
Tender za sada nije objavljen.
The tender has not been published so far.
Zakon o fiskalizaciji transakcija prelazi s klasičnih fiskalnih kasa na softverske sisteme.
The Law on Fiscalisation of Transactions moves from classic fiscal cash registers to software systems.
Ti sistemi u realnom vremenu šalju podatke o prometu Poreznoj upravi, pa bi se smanjila siva ekonomija.
These systems send turnover data to the Tax Administration in real time, so the grey economy would be reduced.
Parlament FBiH usvojio je zakon u januaru 2026, a u Službenom glasniku objavljen je u martu.
The FBiH Parliament adopted the law in January 2026, and it was published in the Official Gazette in March.
Ministar mora donijeti podzakonske akte u roku od 180 dana, ali ih početkom oktobra još nije bilo.
The minister has to adopt the bylaws within 180 days, but at the beginning of October they were still not there.
Prema izvorima Klixa, koalicioni partneri se spore oko toga koja firma treba provesti fiskalizaciju.
According to Klix sources, the coalition partners disagree about which company should carry out the fiscalisation.
Spor se uglavnom odnosi na nabavku i održavanje softvera.
The dispute mostly concerns the purchase and maintenance of the software.
U Republici Srpskoj Porezna uprava već je dodijelila održavanje svog sistema vrijedno 10,8 miliona KM, a stigla je samo jedna ponuda.
In Republika Srpska the Tax Administration has already awarded the maintenance of its system worth 10.8 million KM, and only one bid arrived.

title: Zašto večeras nema utakmica u NBA ligi
Why there are no games in the NBA tonight
body: Večeras u NBA ligi nema nijedne utakmice, jer se u utorak, 3. novembra, u Americi održavaju izbori za Kongres.
There are no NBA games tonight, because elections for Congress are held in America on Tuesday, 3 November.
Liga je namjerno ostavila ovaj dan slobodnim da bi navijači i košarkaška zajednica mogli otići na glasanje.
The league deliberately left this day free so that fans and the basketball community could go and vote.
Svi timovi imaju slobodno veče nakon ponedjeljka, kada je igran pun program utakmica.
All teams have the evening off after Monday, when a full slate of games was played.
Luka Dončić je u ponedjeljak postigao 42 poena i imao 13 asistencija, a Lakersi su pobijedili Heat.
On Monday Luka Dončić scored 42 points and had 13 assists, and the Lakers beat the Heat.
Liga je još prilikom objave rasporeda za sezonu 2026/27 najavila da na Dan izbora neće biti utakmica.
When it released the schedule for the 2026/27 season, the league already announced that there would be no games on Election Day.
Prema Yahoo Sportsu, cilj je da navijačima, igračima i osoblju bude lakše doći do biračkih mjesta.
According to Yahoo Sports, the goal is to make it easier for fans, players and staff to reach polling places.
Nakon što ove sezone više nema pauze, igra se ponovo u srijedu, 4. novembra.
Play resumes on Wednesday, 4 November.
NBA je ovu praksu počela 2022. godine, kada je prvi put preskočila Dan izbora u godini srednjoročnih izbora.
The NBA began this practice in 2022, when it first skipped Election Day in a midterm election year.
Nastavila je i 2023. i 2024. godine.
It continued in 2023 and 2024.
Prošle godine su se utakmice igrale na Dan izbora, pa je ovo četvrti put u pet godina da liga pravi takvu pauzu.
Last year games were played on Election Day, so this is the fourth time in five years that the league takes such a break.

title: Žene u Hrvatskoj od 1. januara tri mjeseca duže čekaju penziju
Women in Croatia wait three months longer for a pension from 1 January
body: Od 1. januara 2027. u Hrvatskoj se mijenjaju uslovi za odlazak žena u penziju, pa će one čekati tri mjeseca duže.
From 1 January 2027 the conditions for women to retire change in Croatia, so they will wait three months longer.
Za redovnu starosnu penziju žene će tada trebati 64 godine i 3 mjeseca života te 15 godina staža.
For a regular old-age pension women will then need 64 years and 3 months of age and 15 years of service.
Ove godine je dovoljno 64 godine i 15 godina staža.
This year 64 years and 15 years of service are enough.
Za raniju penziju trebat će 59 godina i 3 mjeseca života te 34 godine i 3 mjeseca staža.
For an early pension they will need 59 years and 3 months of age and 34 years and 3 months of service.
Granica će rasti i dalje: u 2028. na 64 godine i 6 mjeseci, a u 2029. na 64 godine i 9 mjeseci.
The limit will keep rising: to 64 years and 6 months in 2028 and to 64 years and 9 months in 2029.
Od 1. januara 2030. žene i muškarci imat će iste uslove, a to je 65 godina života i 15 godina staža.
From 1 January 2030 women and men will have the same conditions: 65 years of age and 15 years of service.
Žene koje su ispunile uslove po ranijim pravilima zadržavaju svoja prava.
Women who met the conditions under the earlier rules keep their rights.
U BiH se starosna granica za žene ne povećava svake godine.
In BiH the age limit for women does not rise every year.
I u Federaciji BiH i u Republici Srpskoj starosna penzija ostvaruje se sa 65 godina života i najmanje 15 godina staža.
Both in the Federation of BiH and in Republika Srpska an old-age pension is granted at 65 years of age and at least 15 years of service.
Penzije u Federaciji su ove godine povećane za 11,6 posto, a usklađuju se dvaput godišnje.
Pensions in the Federation were raised by 11.6 percent this year, and they are adjusted twice a year.

title: Aerodrom Sarajevo imao rekordnih 189.472 putnika u oktobru
Sarajevo Airport had a record 189,472 passengers in October
body: Međunarodni aerodrom Sarajevo je u oktobru opslužio 189.472 putnika.
Sarajevo International Airport served 189,472 passengers in October.
To je 4,4 posto više nego u oktobru prošle godine i najbolji oktobar u historiji aerodroma.
That is 4.4 percent more than in October last year and the best October in the airport's history.
Dvomilioniti putnik ove godine očekuje se već ove sedmice.
The two-millionth passenger of this year is expected as early as this week.
Od januara do kraja oktobra aerodrom je imao 1.973.069 putnika, što je 1 posto više nego u istom periodu prošle godine.
From January to the end of October the airport had 1,973,069 passengers, which is 1 percent more than in the same period last year.
Iz aerodroma kažu da rezultat potvrđuje pozitivne trendove u 2026. godini i bolju povezanost BiH s inostranstvom.
The airport says that the result confirms positive trends in 2026 and better connections between BiH and abroad.
Zimski red letenja počeo je 25. oktobra.
The winter flight schedule began on 25 October.
Iz Sarajeva se leti do 18 destinacija s 14 aviokompanija.
Flights from Sarajevo go to 18 destinations with 14 airlines.
Od decembra Wizz Air uvodi nove linije do Bratislave, Berlina i Praga.
From December Wizz Air introduces new routes to Bratislava, Berlin and Prague.
Zima je tradicionalno mirniji period, pa se širenje mreže linija očekuje u proljeće.
Winter is traditionally a quieter period, so an expansion of the route network is expected in spring.
Već su najavljene linije do Ženeve i Bazela, a druge destinacije bit će objavljene kasnije.
Routes to Geneva and Basel have already been announced, and other destinations will be announced later.

title: Vatrogascima u BiH predstavljena oprema za gašenje šumskih požara
Equipment for fighting forest fires presented to firefighters in BiH
body: U Ilidži je održana prezentacija moderne opreme za gašenje požara na otvorenom i vozila za tehničke intervencije.
A presentation of modern equipment for fighting fires in the open and of vehicles for technical interventions was held in Ilidža.
Događaj je organiziralo Vatrogasno društvo Ilidža, zajedno s kolegama iz Slovenije.
The event was organised by the Ilidža Fire Association together with colleagues from Slovenia.
Došli su vatrogasci iz Goražda, Bugojna, Mostara i Sarajeva.
Firefighters came from Goražde, Bugojno, Mostar and Sarajevo.
Među gostima su bili i predstavnici Sarajevo-šuma, općina i civilne zaštite.
Among the guests were also representatives of Sarajevo-šume, municipalities and civil protection.
Opremu je izradila slovenačka kompanija Pratus, koja pravi i nadogradnje za vatrogasna vozila.
The equipment was made by the Slovenian company Pratus, which also makes upgrades for fire vehicles.
Njeni predstavnici pokazali su kako se oprema koristi.
Its representatives showed how the equipment is used.
Vozila se mogu koristiti i kod drugih intervencija, na primjer kod poplava.
The vehicles can also be used in other interventions, for example during floods.
Nijaz Imamović, predsjednik Vatrogasnog društva Ilidža, rekao je da je to bila samo prezentacija.
Nijaz Imamović, president of the Ilidža Fire Association, said that it was only a presentation.
Prema njegovim riječima, danas su na terenu svi koji se bave zaštitom i spašavanjem.
In his words, everyone who deals with protection and rescue was at the site today.
Imamović očekuje da će institucije koje su vidjele opremu odlučiti hoće li je kupiti.
Imamović expects the institutions that saw the equipment to decide whether to buy it.
Nije poznato hoće li je lokalni vatrogasci dobiti.
It is not known whether local firefighters will get it.

title: Sarajevo među najljepšim evropskim gradovima za zimski odmor
Sarajevo among the most beautiful European cities for a winter break
body: Magazin TimeOut uvrstio je Sarajevo među najljepše evropske gradove za zimski odmor u 2026. godini.
TimeOut magazine has included Sarajevo among the most beautiful European cities for a winter break in 2026.
Lista ima 11 gradova, od Arktičkog kruga do Balkana.
The list has 11 cities, from the Arctic Circle to the Balkans.
Pored Sarajeva tu su Zagreb, Pariz, Ljubljana, Amsterdam, Tallinn, Tromsø, Edinburgh, Antwerpen, Innsbruck i Reykjavik.
Besides Sarajevo, it includes Zagreb, Paris, Ljubljana, Amsterdam, Tallinn, Tromsø, Edinburgh, Antwerp, Innsbruck and Reykjavik.
TimeOut piše da su ti gradovi zimi često još privlačniji, a putnicima treba samo još jedan sloj odjeće.
TimeOut writes that these cities are often even more attractive in winter, and travellers only need one more layer of clothes.
Za Sarajevo kažu da se teško uklapa u stereotipe.
About Sarajevo they say that it is hard to fit into stereotypes.
Grad spaja osmansko, austrougarsko i jugoslavensko naslijeđe.
The city combines Ottoman, Austro-Hungarian and Yugoslav heritage.
Na olimpijskim planinama pored grada može se skijati preko dana, a uveče izaći u grad.
On the Olympic mountains next to the city you can ski during the day and go out in the evening.
Zagreb je poznat po nagrađivanom adventu, a Ljubljana po jedinstvenoj božićnoj rasvjeti u centru.
Zagreb is known for its award-winning Advent, and Ljubljana for unique Christmas lights in the centre.
U Amsterdamu se na početku zime otvara klizalište ispred Rijksmuseuma.
In Amsterdam a skating rink opens in front of the Rijksmuseum at the start of winter.
Tromsø nudi vožnju psećim zapregama i traženje polarne svjetlosti.
Tromsø offers dog sledding and the search for the northern lights.
Reykjavik ima toplice, a većina znamenitosti udaljena je oko 20 minuta hoda.
Reykjavik has hot springs, and most sights are about 20 minutes' walk apart.

title: Pomozi.ba poziva frizere da doniraju dio zarade za tople obroke
Pomozi.ba asks hairdressers to donate part of their earnings for hot meals
body: Humanitarno udruženje Pomozi.ba pokrenulo je akciju pod nazivom "Frizeri šišaju, mi kuhamo".
The humanitarian association Pomozi.ba has launched a campaign called "Hairdressers cut, we cook".
Frizerski saloni širom BiH pozvani su da doniraju dio zarade ili cijelu zaradu za jedan dan u novembru.
Hair salons across BiH are invited to donate part or all of their earnings for one day in November.
Novac ide za projekt "Obrok za sve".
The money goes to the project "Obrok za sve" (Meal for All).
Taj projekt osigurava tople obroke za starije, bolesne i socijalno ugrožene osobe.
This project provides hot meals for elderly, sick and socially vulnerable people.
Udruženje svakog dana pripremi više od 1.000 obroka za svoje korisnike.
Every day the association prepares more than 1,000 meals for its users.
Saloni sami biraju dan i iznos, u skladu sa svojim mogućnostima.
Salons choose the day and the amount themselves, according to their means.
Iz udruženja kažu da je svaka donacija važna.
The association says that every donation matters.
Frizeri su i ranije na vlastitu inicijativu organizirali pomoć za korisnike udruženja.
Hairdressers have also earlier organised help for the association's users on their own initiative.
Pomozi.ba se nada da će ova akcija postati tradicija koja se održava svake godine.
Pomozi.ba hopes that this campaign will become a tradition held every year.
Zainteresirani saloni mogu se prijaviti preko online obrasca.
Interested salons can apply through an online form.
Građane mole da o akciji kažu svojim frizerima.
Citizens are asked to tell their hairdressers about the campaign.

title: Schwarzenegger ponovo u božićnom filmu, ovaj put kao Djed Mraz
Schwarzenegger in a Christmas film again, this time as Santa Claus
body: Prime Video je objavio trailer za novu božićnu akcijsku komediju.
Prime Video has released the trailer for a new Christmas action comedy.
Film se zove "The Man with the Bag", a Arnold Schwarzenegger u njemu igra Djeda Mraza.
The film is called "The Man with the Bag", and Arnold Schwarzenegger plays Santa Claus in it.
Alan Ritchson glumi lopova s liste nevaljalih.
Alan Ritchson plays a thief from the naughty list.
Film stiže na platformu 2. decembra.
The film arrives on the platform on 2 December.
Schwarzenegger se tako vraća božićnim filmovima 30 godina nakon komedije "Jingle All the Way" iz 1996. godine.
So Schwarzenegger returns to Christmas films 30 years after the comedy "Jingle All the Way" from 1996.
U priči jedan vilenjak ukrade Djedu Mrazu čarobnu crvenu vreću, pa su pokloni za djecu širom svijeta u opasnosti.
In the story an elf steals Santa's magic red sack, so presents for children around the world are in danger.
Tu ulogu igra Awkwafina.
Awkwafina plays that role.
Djed Mraz zato traži pomoć na svojoj listi nevaljalih i pronalazi poznatog lopova.
So Santa looks for help on his naughty list and finds a well-known thief.
Lopov, njegova kćerka i Djed Mraz moraju izvesti veliku pljačku i vratiti vreću prije Božića.
The thief, his daughter and Santa have to carry out a big heist and get the sack back before Christmas.
Film je režirao Adam Shankman, a producent je Amazon MGM Studios.
The film was directed by Adam Shankman, and the producer is Amazon MGM Studios.
U traileru Schwarzenegger ima bijelu bradu i crveni kaput, a dio humora je u razlici u veličini između njega i krupnog Ritchsona.
In the trailer Schwarzenegger has a white beard and a red coat, and part of the humor is the difference in size between him and the large Ritchson.
Amazon film opisuje kao blagdansku avanturu o drugim šansama i neočekivanim prijateljstvima.
Amazon describes the film as a holiday adventure about second chances and unexpected friendships.
Snimanje u New Yorku počelo je krajem 2024. godine.
Filming in New York began at the end of 2024.

title: Američki student napravio mlazni dron brzine 790 km/h
American student built a jet drone with a speed of 790 km/h
body: Tomas Salvo, student na univerzitetu Georgia Tech u SAD-u, napravio je mlazni dron po imenu Reaper.
Tomas Salvo, a student at Georgia Tech university in the USA, built a jet drone called Reaper.
Kaže da je dron u testu dostigao brzinu od 790 km/h.
He says the drone reached a speed of 790 km/h in a test.
Salvo to smatra svjetskim rekordom za male letjelice na mlazni pogon.
Salvo considers this a world record for small jet-powered aircraft.
Na društvenoj mreži X objavio je da je napravio tri takve letjelice i da je svaka dostigla tu brzinu.
On the social network X he announced that he built three such aircraft and that each of them reached that speed.
Prema portalu Interesting Engineering, test je bio 30. oktobra.
According to the portal Interesting Engineering, the test was on 30 October.
Dron je nosio teret od 1,2 kilograma i četiri minute je održao najveću brzinu.
The drone carried a load of 1.2 kilograms and kept its top speed for four minutes.
Lansira se s kamiona ili šine, a za manje od 20 sekundi popne se na 2.000 metara visine.
It is launched from a truck or a rail, and in less than 20 seconds it climbs to a height of 2,000 metres.
Punom brzinom može preletjeti 50 kilometara.
At full speed it can fly 50 kilometres.
Cijela letjelica teška je oko pet kilograma.
The whole aircraft weighs about five kilograms.
Na motoru je mlaznica od titanija koja je napravljena 3D printanjem.
On the engine there is a titanium nozzle made with 3D printing.
Trup je od karbonskih vlakana, a unutrašnja konstrukcija izrezana je laserom.
The body is made of carbon fibre, and the inner structure was cut with a laser.
Za poređenje, letjelica Kingchaser, koju su u oktobru napravili diplomci Univerziteta u Bathu, dostigla je 330 km/h.
For comparison, the aircraft Kingchaser, which graduates of the University of Bath built in October, reached 330 km/h.
Salvo se nada da će uz manje izmjene preći 800 km/h.
Salvo hopes that with small changes it will pass 800 km/h.

title: Zelenski danas u Berlinu kod Merza, sedmicu prije pregovora
Zelensky in Berlin today with Merz, a week before talks
body: Ukrajinski predsjednik Volodimir Zelenski danas posjećuje Berlin.
Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelensky is visiting Berlin today.
Razgovarat će s njemačkim kancelarom Friedrichom Merzom.
He will talk with German chancellor Friedrich Merz.
Susret je samo sedmicu prije nastavka mirovnih pregovora Rusije i Ukrajine, koje posreduju SAD.
The meeting is only a week before the continuation of peace talks between Russia and Ukraine, mediated by the USA.
O tome piše agencija Reuters.
The agency Reuters writes about this.
Merz je posjetu najavio na poslovnoj konferenciji u Berlinu.
Merz announced the visit at a business conference in Berlin.
Rekao je da će Zelenski doći kod njega odmah nakon podne.
He said that Zelensky will come to him right after noon.
Dodao je da će "stvari tada biti malo drugačije", što Reuters vidi kao aluziju na ukor koji je Zelenski dobio od Donalda Trumpa u Bijeloj kući.
He added that "things will be a bit different then", which Reuters sees as a reference to the scolding Zelensky received from Donald Trump at the White House.
Posjete ukrajinskog predsjednika Njemačkoj drže se u tajnosti do neposredno prije dolaska.
Visits of the Ukrainian president to Germany are kept secret until shortly before his arrival.
Na videu iz Berlina vidi se kako policija postavlja barikade i provjerava vozila na mostu.
A video from Berlin shows police setting up barricades and checking vehicles on a bridge.
Evropski lideri podržali su Zelenskog u posljednjim sedmicama, dok se sukobljavao s Washingtonom.
European leaders have supported Zelensky in recent weeks, while he was in conflict with Washington.
Spor je počeo zbog Trumpovih odluka da kupuje rusko dizel-gorivo i suspenduje dio sankcija.
The dispute began because of Trump's decisions to buy Russian diesel fuel and suspend some sanctions.
Njemačka je, prema Reutersu, najveći podržavatelj Ukrajine otkako je Trump vratio na vlast i povukao američku finansijsku podršku.
According to Reuters, Germany is Ukraine's biggest supporter since Trump returned to power and withdrew American financial support.

title: U BiH evidentirano 13.603 migranta, 40 posto više nego lani
13,603 migrants recorded in BiH, 40 percent more than last year
body: Služba za poslove sa strancima evidentirala je od 1. januara do 30. septembra 13.603 migranta u BiH.
The Service for Foreigners' Affairs recorded 13,603 migrants in BiH from 1 January to 30 September.
To je oko 40 posto više nego prošle godine, rekao je direktor Službe Žarko Laketa.
That is about 40 percent more than last year, said the director of the Service, Žarko Laketa.
Od tog broja, 9.960 migranata iskazalo je namjeru da zatraži azil.
Of that number, 9,960 migrants showed an intention to ask for asylum.
Najviše ih je iz Sudana, Egipta, Afganistana, Turske i Bangladeša.
Most of them are from Sudan, Egypt, Afghanistan, Turkey and Bangladesh.
Samo iz Sudana je 2.404 migranta, a iz Egipta 2.276.
From Sudan alone there are 2,404 migrants, and from Egypt 2,276.
Na dan 30. septembra u prihvatnim centrima boravilo je 1.154 migranta.
On 30 September, 1,154 migrants were staying in reception centres.
Njih 532 bilo je u centru "Blažuj" kod Sarajeva, a 622 u centru "Lipa" u Unsko-sanskom kantonu.
532 of them were in the "Blažuj" centre near Sarajevo, and 622 in the "Lipa" centre in Una-Sana Canton.
Za 3.172 stranca izrečena je mjera protjerivanja, najviše državljanima Turske, Bangladeša i Kine.
An expulsion order was issued for 3,172 foreigners, most of them citizens of Turkey, Bangladesh and China.
U Imigracionom centru nalazi se 218 stranaca.
There are 218 foreigners in the Immigration Centre.
Laketa je podsjetio da je BiH tranzitna zemlja za migrante koji žele u Zapadnu Evropu.
Laketa reminded that BiH is a transit country for migrants who want to go to Western Europe.
Rekao je i da Rusi, Turci i Kinezi mogu doći u BiH bez viza.
He also said that Russians, Turks and Chinese can come to BiH without visas.
Prema njegovim riječima, neki pokušavaju zloupotrijebiti tu pogodnost.
According to him, some try to abuse that benefit.
Služba je u istom periodu odobrila i 5.980 privremenih boravaka.
In the same period the Service also approved 5,980 temporary residence permits.

title: Predsjednik KK Bosna ogorčen zbog malog broja gledalaca
KK Bosna president upset about the small number of spectators
body: Predsjednik košarkaškog kluba Bosna Nihad Selimović ogorčen je malom posjetom na domaćim utakmicama u Zetri.
The president of basketball club Bosna, Nihad Selimović, is upset about the low attendance at home games in Zetra.
Na konferenciji za medije rekao je da klub igra dobro u Eurocupu i ABA ligi, ali da podrške publike nema.
At a press conference he said that the club is playing well in the Eurocup and the ABA League, but that there is no support from fans.
Posebno ga smeta što je u Beču bilo više navijača Bosne nego u Sarajevu.
What bothers him especially is that there were more Bosna fans in Vienna than in Sarajevo.
Protiv Bahčešehira prodato je samo 287 karata, a 1.366 ulaznica podijeljeno je besplatno.
Against Bahçeşehir only 287 tickets were sold, and 1,366 tickets were given away for free.
Selimović kaže da ulaznice nisu skupe, jer su 60 posto njih po 10 i 15 maraka.
Selimović says the tickets are not expensive, because 60 percent of them cost 10 and 15 marks.
Za porodičnu tribinu ulaznica košta 5 eura, a kod Partizana 51 euro.
A ticket for the family stand costs 5 euros, and at Partizan 51 euros.
Od te utakmice klub je zaradio 6.030 KM, a samo organizacija koštala je 30 do 40 hiljada KM.
The club earned 6,030 KM from that game, and the organisation alone cost 30 to 40 thousand KM.
Zato je poručio da od sada niko neće dobiti besplatnu ulaznicu, čak i ako dvorana bude prazna.
So he said that from now on nobody will get a free ticket, even if the hall is empty.
Selimović je rekao da je klub od prethodne uprave naslijedio dug od milion i po KM.
Selimović said the club inherited a debt of one and a half million KM from the previous management.
Više od 600.000 KM već je vraćeno, a tekuće obaveze se redovno plaćaju.
More than 600,000 KM has already been paid back, and current obligations are paid regularly.
Smatra da bi sljedeća sezona mogla biti teška ako se odnos publike ne promijeni.
He thinks next season could be difficult if the attitude of the fans does not change.
Bosna sutra u 19:30 igra protiv Balkana u Zetri, a Selimović je molio navijače da napune dvoranu.
Tomorrow at 19:30 Bosna plays against Balkan in Zetra, and Selimović asked fans to fill the hall.

title: Dio Alipašina Polja danas bez grijanja, pogođeno 549 stanova
Part of Alipašino Polje without heating today, 549 flats affected
body: Korisnici u 549 stanova na Alipašinom Polju danas su bez grijanja.
Users in 549 flats in Alipašino Polje are without heating today.
Razlog je prekid struje u kotlovnici K-3, iz koje se snabdijevaju toplotom.
The reason is a power cut at boiler room K-3, from which they get their heat.
Prekid napajanja planiran je od 9 do 15 sati.
The power cut is planned from 9 to 15 hours.
Kako su saopćile Toplane Sarajevo, Elektrodistribucija je najavila radove na transformatorskoj stanici.
As Toplane Sarajevo announced, Elektrodistribucija announced works on a transformer station.
Stanica napaja kotlovnicu K-3, a rekonstruira se jedan njen dio.
The station supplies boiler room K-3, and one part of it is being reconstructed.
Bez toplote su zgrade u Ulici Ive Andrića s brojevima 2, 4, 6 i 8.
The buildings on Ive Andrić Street with numbers 2, 4, 6 and 8 are without heat.
Isto je i na Trgu međunarodnog prijateljstva, od broja 1 do 9.
The same applies on International Friendship Square, from number 1 to 9.
Prema informacijama Elektroprivrede BiH, radovi počinju u 9 sati.
According to information from Elektroprivreda BiH, the works begin at 9 o'clock.
Prekid bi trebao trajati do 15 sati.
The cut should last until 15 hours.
Iz Toplana kažu da će grijanje ponovo raditi kada radovi završe i kada se vrati redovno napajanje strujom.
Toplane say that heating will work again when the works are finished and regular power supply returns.

title: Novi Xiaomi telefoni stižu u cijeli svijet
New Xiaomi phones are coming to the whole world
body: Xiaomi ima dva nova telefona.
Xiaomi has two new phones.
Zovu se Xiaomi 18 Pro i 18 Pro Max.
They are called Xiaomi 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max.
Telefoni su u Kini od septembra.
The phones have been in China since September.
Ovog mjeseca stižu i u druge zemlje.
This month they are also coming to other countries.
Ljudi ih uskoro mogu kupiti i izvan Kine.
People can soon buy them outside China too.

title: Kiša u Bosni, sunce u Hercegovini
Rain in Bosnia, sun in Herzegovina
body: U Bosni i Hercegovini danas pada kiša.
Today it is raining in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Kiša će padati i sutra.
It will rain tomorrow too.
Na planinama može pasti malo snijega.
A little snow may fall in the mountains.
Od srijede će u Hercegovini biti sunčano.
From Wednesday it will be sunny in Herzegovina.
U petak ujutro će biti hladno.
On Friday morning it will be cold.
Temperatura može pasti na minus dva stepena.
The temperature can drop to minus two degrees.

title: Spalletti pohvalio gol Kerima Alajbegovića
Spalletti praised Kerim Alajbegović's goal
body: Juventus je pobijedio Napoli rezultatom 2:0.
Juventus beat Napoli 2:0.
Prvi gol je dao Kerim Alajbegović.
Kerim Alajbegović scored the first goal.
On igra za reprezentaciju Bosne i Hercegovine.
He plays for the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team.
Gol je dao udarcem iz daljine.
He scored with a long-range shot.
Trener Luciano Spalletti je rekao da je gol bio odličan.
Coach Luciano Spalletti said the goal was excellent.
Kada Kerim ide naprijed, on je najbolji na toj poziciji.
When Kerim goes forward, he is the best in that position.
Zato je u drugom poluvremenu igrao više naprijed.
That is why he played further forward in the second half.

title: Messi donio pobjedu Inter Miamiju
Messi brought Inter Miami a win
body: Inter Miami je igrao protiv New Englanda.
Inter Miami played against New England.
New England je prvo vodio.
New England was ahead at first.
Na kraju je Inter Miami pobijedio rezultatom 2:1.
In the end Inter Miami won 2:1.
Lionel Messi je dao jedan gol.
Lionel Messi scored one goal.
Imao je i jednu asistenciju.
He also had one assist.
Zbog ove pobjede tim iduće godine igra na velikom takmičenju.
Because of this win, the team plays in a big competition next year.

title: Lažno upozorenje na telefonima u Ukrajini i Rusiji
A false warning on phones in Ukraine and Russia
body: U nedjelju navečer milioni ljudi dobili su poruku na telefonu.
On Sunday evening millions of people got a message on their phones.
Poruka je bila upozorenje na nuklearni napad.
The message was a warning about a nuclear attack.
Ali upozorenje nije bilo istinito.
But the warning was not true.
Neko je hakovao ukrajinsku aplikaciju za uzbune.
Someone hacked the Ukrainian app for alerts.
Kasnije je i Rusija rekla da je njena aplikacija napadnuta.
Later Russia also said that its app was attacked.

title: Ryanair zaradio manje novca
Ryanair earned less money
body: Ryanair je velika avio-kompanija iz Irske.
Ryanair is a big airline from Ireland.
Kompanija je zaradila 2,15 milijardi eura.
The company earned 2.15 billion euros.
To je dobit za šest mjeseci, do kraja septembra.
That is the profit for six months, up to the end of September.
Prošle godine dobit je bila 2,54 milijarde eura.
Last year the profit was 2.54 billion euros.
Dobit je pala za 15 posto.
The profit fell by 15 percent.

title: Ukrajinac oborio Guinnessov rekord na televiziji
A Ukrainian broke a Guinness record on TV
body: Supertalent je hrvatska televizijska emisija.
Supertalent is a Croatian TV show.
U emisiji je nastupio Oleksandr Saša Khoruzenko iz Ukrajine.
Oleksandr Saša Khoruzenko from Ukraine performed on the show.
On se vrti u velikom metalnom točku.
He spins inside a big metal wheel.
Za 30 sekundi napravio je 56 okreta.
In 30 seconds he made 56 turns.
Stari Guinnessov rekord bio je 49 okreta.
The old Guinness record was 49 turns.
Članica žirija Maja Šuput uporedila ga je s Aladinom.
Jury member Maja Šuput compared him to Aladdin.

title: Dončić dao 45 poena protiv Toronta
Dončić scored 45 points against Toronto
body: Luka Dončić igra košarku za Los Angeles Lakerse.
Luka Dončić plays basketball for the Los Angeles Lakers.
Lakersi su pobijedili Toronto rezultatom 131:125.
The Lakers beat Toronto 131:125.
Dončić je dao 45 poena.
Dončić scored 45 points.
Imao je i 15 skokova, šest asistencija i pet ukradenih lopti.
He also had 15 rebounds, six assists and five steals.
Postavio je i novi rekord.
He also set a new record.

title: Salma Hayek ima novu, plavu kosu
Salma Hayek has new, blonde hair
body: Glumica Salma Hayek bila je na zabavi za Noć vještica.
Actress Salma Hayek was at a Halloween party.
Zabava je bila u subotu u Los Angelesu.
The party was on Saturday in Los Angeles.
Salma obično ima tamnu kosu.
Salma usually has dark hair.
Ovaj put je imala plavu kosu do ramena.
This time she had shoulder-length blonde hair.
Htjela je odati počast prijateljici Penelope Cruz.
She wanted to pay tribute to her friend Penélope Cruz.
Odati počast znači pokazati poštovanje.
To pay tribute means to show respect.
Penelope ima takvu kosu u novom filmu „The Invite“.
Penélope has hair like that in the new film "The Invite".

title: Zemljotres probudio ljude u Sarajevu i kod Mostara
An earthquake woke people in Sarajevo and near Mostar
body: U ponedjeljak u 01:17 u Sarajevu je bio zemljotres.
On Monday at 01:17 there was an earthquake in Sarajevo.
Zemljotres je probudio mnoge ljude.
The earthquake woke up many people.
Ljudi su ga osjetili i na Ilidži i u Vogošći.
People also felt it in Ilidža and Vogošća.
Mnogi su prvo čuli jak zvuk, kao eksploziju.
Many first heard a loud sound, like an explosion.
U 04:35 zemlja se tresla i kod Mostara.
At 04:35 the ground also shook near Mostar.
Najviše prijava je stiglo iz Blagaja.
Most reports came from Blagaj.
Zemljotres je trajao samo jednu ili dvije sekunde.
The earthquake lasted only one or two seconds.

title: Republika Srpska: manje ljudi, više automobila
Republika Srpska: fewer people, more cars
body: U Republici Srpskoj danas živi manje ljudi nego 2015. godine.
Fewer people live in Republika Srpska today than in 2015.
Razlika je 56.695 ljudi.
The difference is 56,695 people.
Ali automobila ima mnogo više.
But there are many more cars.
Prošle godine bilo je 417.373 automobila.
Last year there were 417,373 cars.
Sada ima 378 automobila na 1.000 ljudi.
There are now 378 cars per 1,000 people.
Prije 10 godina bilo ih je samo 240.
10 years ago there were only 240.
Plate su veće, a polovni automobili su jeftiniji.
Wages are higher, and used cars are cheaper.
Do kraja godine može biti skoro 450.000 automobila.
By the end of the year there could be almost 450,000 cars.

title: Latvija prvi put vodi Vijeće sigurnosti UN-a
Latvia leads the UN Security Council for the first time
body: Od 1. novembra Latvija vodi Vijeće sigurnosti UN-a.
Since 1 November Latvia has led the UN Security Council.
To je prvi put u historiji Latvije.
It is the first time in Latvia's history.
Latvija će voditi Vijeće cijeli novembar.
Latvia will lead the Council for the whole of November.
Vodit će sve sastanke u tom mjesecu.
It will chair all the meetings that month.
Latvija želi da rat u Ukrajini ostane važna tema.
Latvia wants the war in Ukraine to remain an important topic.
U utorak, 3. novembra, Vijeće će birati sudije Međunarodnog suda pravde.
On Tuesday, 3 November, the Council will elect judges of the International Court of Justice.
Vijeće će imati važnu ulogu i u izboru novog šefa UN-a.
The Council will also have an important role in choosing the new head of the UN.

title: Antonelli je najmlađi prvak Formule 1
Antonelli is the youngest Formula 1 champion
body: Kimi Antonelli je novi svjetski prvak u Formuli 1.
Kimi Antonelli is the new Formula 1 world champion.
On ima samo 20 godina i vozi za Mercedes.
He is only 20 years old and drives for Mercedes.
Titulu je osvojio na trci u Meksiku.
He won the title at the race in Mexico.
Na toj trci bio je treći.
He finished third in that race.
Do kraja sezone ostale su još 4 trke.
There are still 4 races left until the end of the season.
Prije njega najmlađi prvak bio je Sebastian Vettel.
Before him, the youngest champion was Sebastian Vettel.
Vettel je 2010. godine imao 23 godine.
In 2010 Vettel was 23 years old.
Antonelli je prvi italijanski prvak nakon 1953. godine.
Antonelli is the first Italian champion since 1953.
